# exp/perspective-family — eye-check gate (F-format)

**Method.** Marks generated by `build.py` from `grid.json` + brandlib helpers;
battery rendered through the Phase-0 pipeline and inspected full-size.

| # | Check | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Three-projection ladder reads as ONE family (hub-gold recurrence) | PASS — the gold point carries identity across all three |
| 2 | Temple elevation on indigo (poster register) | PASS — the battery's strongest render; drop + dome + gold waterline is ownable |
| 3 | Favicon drop-over-dome 16/24/32/48, light + dark | PASS — reads as a tiny shrine at 16 px; distinctive vs any circled-dot favicon |
| 4 | Foundation wheel | PASS after fix — first render had the Āditya dots floating as polka dots; added the rim band (inner ring 0.755R) and petal midribs |
| 5 | Anāhata in circle-crop avatar | PASS — soft, heart-register; gold centre keeps it branded |
| 6 | Anāhata floral-genericity in isolation | WATCH — acceptable in family context; flagged as a governance rule (never standalone without gold centre / family context) |
| 7 | Receipt sim (foundation wheel at 74 px) | PASS |
| 8 | 6 cm mono temple elevation | PASS — scallops and dome hold in single colour |
| 9 | Elevation crop discipline | RULE FOR PHASE 3 — never crop mid-linga; clear-space = one dome-radius |

**Net:** the architecture works; the elevation and favicon are the standout
artefacts. Carries: anāhata governance rule (#6), elevation clear-space (#9).
